# Monthly Gold Price Forecast Project

```{r}
library(fpp2)
library(forecast)

# Load Data

gold.data <- read.csv("C:/Users/jeant/Downloads/gold-data.csv")
```


```{r}
View(gold.data)

```
## Time Series of gold prices from October 2022 to October 2026
```{r}
gold.data_up <- gold.data$Gold_Price
gold.data_ts <- ts(gold.data_up, frequency = 12, start = c(2022,10)) 
plot(gold.data_ts, main= "Monthly Gold Trend (Oct 2022 - Oct 2026")
```
* Due the start of US - Iran in February 2026, the gold price skyrocketed and dropped in July 2026.

### Time Series 
```{r}
gold.data_wins <- window(gold.data_ts, start = c(2025,10))
plot(gold.data_wins)
```
  * Summary
  
## Central Tendency
  
```{r}
summary(gold.data_wins)
```
## Graph plots

```{r}
boxplot(gold.data_wins, main= "Boxplot of gold Data from (October 2024)")
hist(gold.data_wins, main= "Histogram of gold Data from (October 2024)")
Acf(gold.data_wins, main= "Acf of gold Data from (October 2024)")

```
## Summarization


# Decomposition **Problem**
#### Plot the decomposition of the time series

```{r}
stl_decomp <- stl(gold.data_ts, s.window = "periodic")
plot(stl_decomp, main = 'Decomposition plot')
```
```{r}
decom <- decompose(gold.data_ts)
decom$gold_Price
```



### Foresting using Naive Method
```{r}
gold_naive = naive(gold.data_wins)
plot(gold_naive, main = "Naive Forecast")
```
### Residual Analysis
```{r}
plot(gold_naive$residuals, main = "Naive forecast residuals plot")
```
### Histogram of the Residuals Using Naive
```{r}
hist(gold_naive$residuals, main ='Histogram of Residuals')
```
### Plotting fitted Values vs Residuals
```{r}
cbind(Fitted = fitted(gold_naive),
      Residuals=residuals(gold_naive)) %>%
  as.data.frame() %>%
  ggplot(aes(x=Fitted, y=Residuals)) + geom_point()
```
####Plotting Actual Values vs Residual Values
```{r}
cbind(Actual = gold.data_wins,
      Residuals=residuals(gold_naive)) %>%
  as.data.frame() %>%
  ggplot(aes(x=Actual, y=Residuals)) + geom_point()
```
### Plotting Acf for the Residual
```{r}
Acf(gold_naive$residuals, main = "ACF of Naive residuals")
```
### Printing the five Measures of Naive Method
```{r}
naive_accuracy <- accuracy(gold_naive)
naive_accuracy
```
## Forecasting for the Next Year 2027
```{r}
forecast(gold.data_wins)
plot(forecast(gold.data_wins))
```
#### Summarizing 


## Plotting Simple Moving Average
```{r}
mavg3_forecast = ma(gold.data_wins,order=3)
mavg6_forecast = ma(gold.data_wins,order=6)
mavg9_forecast = ma(gold.data_wins,order=9) 
plot(gold.data_wins, main = "Plot along with moving averages")
lines(mavg3_forecast, col="Red")
lines(mavg6_forecast, col="Blue")
lines(mavg9_forecast, col="Green")
```
### Forecasting the gold price for the next 12 months
```{r}
MA3_forecast <- forecast(mavg3_forecast, h = 12)
plot(MA3_forecast)
```
### Forecasting the gold price for the next 12 months using Simple Moving Average
```{r}
ses_data <- ses(gold.data_wins)
plot(ses_data)
```
### Summary the Five Measures of Simple Moving Average
```{r}
summary(ses_data)
```
### Plotting the Residual Values of Simple Moving Average
```{r}
plot(ses_data$residuals, main = "Simple Smoothing forecast residuals plot")
```
### Plotting a Histogram of the Residual Values
```{r}
hist(ses_data$residuals, main ='Histogram of Residuals')
```
### Plot of fitted values vs. Residuals
```{r}
cbind(Fitted = fitted(ses_data),
      Residuals=residuals(ses_data)) %>%
  as.data.frame() %>%
  ggplot(aes(x=Fitted, y=Residuals)) + geom_point()
```
### Plotting of Actual values vs. Residuals

```{r}
cbind(Actual = gold.data_wins,
      Residuals=residuals(ses_data)) %>%
  as.data.frame() %>%
  ggplot(aes(x=Actual, y=Residuals)) + geom_point()
```
### Plotting the ACF vs Residuals
```{r}
Acf(ses_data$residuals, main = "ACF of Naive residuals")
```
### Printing the 5 measures of Accuracy for this Forecasting Technique
```{r}
ses_accuracy <- accuracy(ses_data)
ses_accuracy
```
### Time series value for next year
```{r}
forecast(ses_data)
plot(forecast(ses_data))
```
## HoltWinters
### Performing Holt-Winters forecast for next 12 months for the time series.

# ARIMA
```{r}
ndiffs(gold.data_ts)
```

```{r}
tsdisplay(gold.data_ts)
```
```{r}
goldtimeseriesdiff1 <- diff(gold.data_ts, differences=1)
plot(goldtimeseriesdiff1)
```
```{r}
tsdisplay(goldtimeseriesdiff1)
```
```{r}
auto_fit <- auto.arima(goldtimeseriesdiff1, trace=TRUE, stepwise = FALSE)
```
```{r}
auto_fit
```
```{r}
attributes(auto_fit)
```
```{r}
plot(forecast(auto_fit, h=8, level = c(99.5)))
```
```{r}
Acf(auto_fit$residuals)
```
```{r}
Box.test(residuals(auto_fit), lag = 20, type = "Ljung")
```
```{r}
plot.ts(residuals(auto_fit))
```
```{r}
hist(auto_fit$residuals)
```
```{r}
tsdiag(auto_fit)
```
```{r}
plot(euretail)
```
```{r}
nsdiffs(euretail)
```
```{r}
ndiffs(euretail)
```
```{r}
ndiffs((diff(euretail, 4)))
```
```{r}
tsdisplay(diff(diff(euretail, 4)))
```
```{r}
fit3 <- auto.arima(euretail,trace = TRUE, stepwise = FALSE)
```
```{r}
fit3
```
```{r}
Acf(fit3$residuals)
```
```{r}
Box.test(residuals(fit3), lag = 20, type = "Ljung")
```
```{r}
plot.ts(residuals(fit3))
```
```{r}
hist(fit3$residuals)
```
```{r}
tsdiag(fit3)
```
